newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Arabia offers two- to five-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia offers two- to five-year bonds.

text.p: Saudi Arabia offered government bonds worth 1.5 billion riyals on Saturday, a banker said.
The bonds are offered to Saudi-based banks every two weeks by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency on a Saturday.
The banker said the annual coupon for two years was 5.89 percent, three years 6.05 percent, four years 6.17 percent and five years 6.34 percent.
The rates are fixed at 30 basis points above the comparable U.S. note for two years, 35 points for three years, 40 points for four years and 50 points for five years.
